title: Intention Ledger — Sprint Microsteps & KPI Scratchpad
content:
PURPOSE:
Quick, low-friction scratchpad for an intention-led sprint. Not a polished OKR doc; more like a gardener's notebook — daily microsteps, soft metrics, and tiny experiments I can actually run and measure.

SPRINT WINDOW: 2026-01-26 -> 2026-02-23 (4 weeks) — labeling this a "focus sprint" for deep-work habits and a microproductivity experiment.

NORTH-STAR (single signal):
- Focused deep-work hours per week (uninterrupted): baseline 5.5h (avg last 8 weeks) -> target 12h by end of sprint.

SECONDARY SIGNALS (quick, noisy metrics):
- Distraction-free sessions (Pomodoro-style, 45/15): baseline 6/wk -> target 12/wk
- Weekly shipped small outcome (doc, automation, tiny script): baseline 0.6 -> target 1
- Energy score (end-of-day, 1–5): baseline ~3 -> target 4

SCORING RUBRIC (how I decide if sprint "wins"):
- Win: deep-work >=12h AND shipped >=1/week for 3 of 4 weeks
- Partial: one of the two targets met consistently
- Rework: neither meets; surface blockers and try new micro-interventions

MICROSTEPS (daily / weekly experiments):
- M1 (Morning anchor): 20m writing/notes (7:30–7:50) before Slack/email.
- M2 (No-meet block): 2x 90m no-meeting blocks Tue/Thu mornings. Calendar: mark as "FOCUS — do not book".
- M3 (Distraction sieve): install Simple Blocker for social sites 9:00–18:00; 60m override lock per day.
- M4 (End-of-day triage): 10m triage + 3 bullet priorities for tomorrow.
- M5 (Weekly shipping hour): Friday 10–11am reserved for a small deliverable (doc + 1 automation).

CHECK-IN TEMPLATE (use when doing weekly retrospective) — quick questions I answer in 10 minutes:
1) What did I ship?
2) Deep-work hours this week? (sum)
3) Energy trend (avg)?
4) Biggest blocker?
5) One microstep to keep / change next week.

WEEKLY NOTES (scratch):
- 2026-01-26 (kickoff): baseline measurement done. Set calendar blocks. Feeling optimistic.
- 2026-02-02: managed 9h deep-work (surprise), shipped a small automation to clean meeting notes. Energy 3.8. Notice: Slack still seeps into morning.
- 2026-02-09: 7h deep-work (travel day impacted), shipped doc draft for personal playbook. Try: move morning anchor earlier to 7:00.
- 2026-02-16: 11h deep-work (almost there). Shipped small CLI tool to format notes. Energy 4.2. Success: two uninterrupted 90m sessions.

RETRO (mid-sprint observations):
- What worked: concrete calendar fencing + explicit "ship hour" increased output. Pomodoro 45/15 felt less punitive than 25/5.
- What didn't: habit friction in mornings when inbox is noisy; social site blocking needs stricter rules.
- Surprises: burst of motivation after shipping small automation — compounding motivation effect.

HYPOTHESES (for next micro-experiments):
- H1: Moving morning anchor earlier (7:00) will increase deep-work hours by 30% because fewer interruptions.
- H2: Replacing Slack mobile notifications with a single digest will reduce morning context switches by 50%.
- H3: A visible weekly streak counter (calendar emoji) will increase shipping cadence.

QUICK WINS / TODOS (next 7 days):
- Lock Tue/Thu 9–10:30 for no meetings (apply to calendar).
- Configure Simple Blocker to strict mode Mon-Fri 9–17.
- Create a tiny habit tracker (checkbox in Notion) + add emoji to calendar events to show streak.
- Draft micro-playbook for "ship hour" with checklist (10 steps).

BLOCKERS / OPEN QUESTIONS:
- How to handle urgent pull requests that arrive during focus blocks? Quick rule: 15-min triage window at block midpoint; otherwise defer.
- Social obligations: two recurring catchups are optional but important for team fit. Can they move? Action: propose batching.

NOTES TO SELF (short reminders):
- Ship > polish. 1 small visible result is worth more than 3 half-finished refinements.
- Celebrate streaks (tiny emoji count).
- When energy low, prefer cleaning/organizing tasks over heavy design work.

MEASUREMENT LOG (manual entries):
- Week 1 (2026-01-26 -> 02-01): Deep-work 5.5h, shipped 0.5, energy 3.6
- Week 2 (2026-02-02 -> 02-08): Deep-work 9.0h, shipped 1, energy 3.8
- Week 3 (2026-02-09 -> 02-15): Deep-work 7.0h, shipped 1, energy 3.9
- Week 4 (2026-02-16 -> 02-23): Deep-work 11.0h, shipped 1.5, energy 4.2

FINAL THOUGHT (end of sprint draft):
- Outcome: decent improvement toward north-star but still short of consistency.
- Next step: run micro-experiment with earlier morning anchor and stricter blocker for 4 weeks; keep the shipping hour and add a 10m weekly review ritual at Friday EOD.

OPEN IDEAS (parking lot):
- Try 3-week sprints (instead of 4) to increase urgency.
- Share playbook with one peer for accountability.
- Automate measurement: small script to parse calendar and compute uninterrupted block duration.

END — rough and personal. Keep this as the working ledger; if a pattern emerges, formalize into an actual OKR doc.
